title: Learning-Based 3D Reconstruction of Power Networks from Aerial Point Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2609.23915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end framework for reconstructing overhead power utility network topology and extracting span-level physical metadata from large-scale aerial LiDAR. The pipeline begins with semantic segmentation of the input point cloud using an improved KPConv-based model, in which data sampling and loss functions are adapted to emphasize pole and conductor (wire) classes. Network topology inference then proceeds in two stages: (i) pole instances are obtained by clustering pole-class points and validating candidates using geometric criteria, including height and verticality estimated via PCA, and (ii) candidate pole pairs are evaluated using a heuristic method and a lightweight ResNet-based classifier on 2D top-view projections of pole and wire point distributions to determine whether a physical conductor span exists. translated_title: 基于学习的航空点云电力网络三维重建
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个端到端框架，用于从大规模航空激光雷达（LiDAR）数据中重建架空电力网络的拓扑结构并提取档距级的物理元数据。该流程首先使用改进的基于KPConv的模型对输入点云进行语义分割，其中对数据采样和损失函数进行了调整，以突出电杆和导线（电线）类别。随后，网络拓扑推断分两个阶段进行：(i) 通过对电杆类别的点进行聚类，并利用几何准则（包括通过PCA估计的高度和垂直度）验证候选对象，从而获得电杆实例；(ii) 利用启发式方法和基于轻量级ResNet的分类器，对电杆和导线点分布的2D俯视投影进行评估，以判断候选电杆对之间是否存在物理导线档距。通过显式地对候选档距进行分类，该方法缓解了启发式连接方法的常见失效模式。
tldr: 本文提出一种端到端框架，通过改进的KPConv语义分割和两阶段拓扑推断（电杆实例聚类验证与基于轻量级ResNet分类器的档距判别），从大规模航空激光雷达点云中重建架空电力网络拓扑并提取档距级物理元数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an end-to-end framework that reconstructs overhead power network topology and extracts span-level physical metadata from large-scale aerial LiDAR, using improved KPConv-based semantic segmentation and two-stage topology inference combining pole instance clustering with a lightweight ResNet classifier for explicit span validation.
